        }
        for c in ranking
    ]
    return all_res


def load_model(ckpt_path, condition):
    log(f"Loading {condition} model from {ckpt_path} ...")
    t0 = time.time()

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        ckpt_path,
        torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
        trust_remote_code=True,
        attn_implementation="eager",
    ).to(DEVICE).eval()

    processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(
        ckpt_path, trust_remote_code=True, num_crops=1
    )

    log(f"  Model loaded in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")
    return model, processor


def run_pipeline(model, processor, condition, results_dir, args):
    global N_IMG_TOKENS, IMG_TOKEN_ID
    os.makedirs(results_dir, exist_ok=True)

    nt = 2 if args.dry_run else len(TASKS)
    nd = 1 if args.dry_run else N_DEMOS
    ns = 2 if args.dry_run else N_TIMESTEPS
    nps = 2 if args.dry_run else N_PROBE_SEEDS
    cls_layers = [0, 8, 16, 24, 31] if args.dry_run else None

    log(f"=== {condition.upper()} pipeline ===")
    log(f"Config: tasks={nt} demos={nd} timesteps={ns} seeds={nps} dry_run={args.dry_run}")
    log(f"Output: {results_dir}")

    IMG_TOKEN_ID = detect_image_token_id(processor)
    log(f"  Image token ID: {IMG_TOKEN_ID}")

    log("Validating token layout ...")
    hdf5_path = os.path.join(DATA, f"{TASKS[0]}_demo.hdf5")
    with h5py.File(hdf5_path, "r") as hf:
        img = Image.fromarray(hf["data/demo_0/obs/agentview_rgb"][0])
    inputs = prepare_inputs(processor, INSTRUCTIONS[0], img)
    original_ids = inputs["input_ids"].clone()
    log(f"  input_ids shape: {inputs['input_ids'].shape}")
    if "pixel_values" in inputs:
        log(f"  pixel_values shape: {inputs['pixel_values'].shape}")
    if "image_sizes" in inputs:
        log(f"  image_sizes: {inputs['image_sizes']}")

    with torch.no_grad():
        out = model(**inputs, output_hidden_states=True, output_attentions=True)

    hs0_shape = out.hidden_states[0].shape
    log(f"  hidden_states[0] shape: {hs0_shape}")

    tr = find_token_regions(original_ids, IMG_TOKEN_ID)
    N_IMG_TOKENS = tr["image"][1] - tr["image"][0]
    log(f"  Token regions: bos={tr['bos']} image={tr['image']} text={tr['text']}")
    log(f"  N_IMG_TOKENS={N_IMG_TOKENS}")
    log(f"  Total seq_len: input_ids={inputs['input_ids'].shape[1]}, hidden={hs0_shape[1]}")

    n_attn_layers = len(out.attentions)
    attn_shape = out.attentions[0].shape
    log(f"  Attention: {n_attn_layers} layers, shape={attn_shape}")

    del out, inputs
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    t1 = time.time()
    reps, actions, labels, attn_ratio_sum, attn_ratio_sq_sum, attn_n = extract_features(
        model, processor, nt, nd, ns, IMG_TOKEN_ID
    )
    log(f"Phase 1: {time.time()-t1:.1f}s")

    if not args.skip_probing:
        t2 = time.time()
        probe_res = run_probing(reps, actions, nps)
        with open(os.path.join(results_dir, "action_r2_probing.json"), "w") as f:
            json.dump(probe_res, f, indent=2)
        log(f"Phase 2: {time.time()-t2:.1f}s -> action_r2_probing.json")

    t3 = time.time()
    attn_res = analyze_attention(attn_ratio_sum, attn_ratio_sq_sum, attn_n)
    with open(os.path.join(results_dir, "l1_attention_profile.json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump(attn_res, f, indent=2)
    log(f"Phase 3: {time.time()-t3:.1f}s -> l1_attention_profile.json")

    del attn_ratio_sum, attn_ratio_sq_sum

    t4 = time.time()
    cls_res = run_classification(reps, labels, layers=cls_layers)
    with open(os.path.join(results_dir, "cross_instruction_classification.json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump(cls_res, f, indent=2)
    log(f"Phase 4: {time.time()-t4:.1f}s -> cross_instruction_classification.json")

    del reps, actions, labels

    if condition == "trained" and not args.skip_counterfactual:
        t5 = time.time()
        cf_res = run_counterfactual(model, processor, nt, nd, ns)
        with open(os.path.join(results_dir, "counterfactual_combined.json"), "w") as f:
            json.dump(cf_res, f, indent=2)
        log(f"Phase 5: {time.time()-t5:.1f}s -> counterfactual_combined.json")
    elif condition != "trained":
        log("Phase 5: skipped (untrained model cannot generate meaningful actions)")


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--skip-counterfactual", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--skip-probing", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument(
        "--conditions", nargs="+", choices=["trained", "untrained"],
        default=["trained", "untrained"],
        help="Conditions to run (trained untrained)",
    )
    args = p.parse_args()

    conditions = args.conditions
    log(f"Pipeline conditions: {conditions}")

    t_start = time.time()

    for condition in conditions:
        if condition == "trained":
            ckpt = TRAINED_CKPT
        elif condition == "untrained":
            if os.path.exists(os.path.join(UNTRAINED_CACHE, "config.json")):
                ckpt = UNTRAINED_CACHE
            else:
                ckpt = UNTRAINED_CKPT
                log(f"  Will download untrained model from {ckpt}")
        else:
            log(f"  Unknown condition: {condition}, skipping")
            continue

        results_dir = os.path.join(RESULTS_BASE, condition)

        try:
            model, processor = load_model(ckpt, condition)
        except Exception as e:
            log(f"  ERROR loading {condition} model: {e}")
            log(f"  Skipping {condition} condition")
            continue

        tc = time.time()
        run_pipeline(model, processor, condition, results_dir, args)
        log(f"  {condition} complete in {(time.time()-tc)/60:.1f} min")

        del model, processor
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    log(f"All done in {(time.time()-t_start)/60:.1f} min")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def run_rsa(reps, actions, task_labels, n_sample=20, bootstrap_n=1000, seed=42):
    log("Phase 5: RSA analysis")
    from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist
    from scipy.stats import spearmanr

    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n_tasks = int(task_labels.max()) + 1
    layers_to_check = [0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 31]

    results = {
        "method": {
            "pairing": "within-task",
            "rep_distance": "cosine",
            "act_distance": "euclidean",
            "n_sample": n_sample,
            "bootstrap_n": bootstrap_n,
            "seed": seed,
            "n_tasks": n_tasks,
            "layers": layers_to_check,
        },
        "per_layer": {},
    }

    for l in layers_to_check:
        for pos in ("image_mean", "last_preaction"):
            task_rhos = []
            for ti in range(n_tasks):
                mask = task_labels == ti
                X = reps[l][pos][mask]
                A = actions[mask]
                n = len(X)
                if n < n_sample:
                    continue

                idx = rng.choice(n, size=n_sample, replace=False)
                Xs, As = X[idx], A[idx]

                rep_d = pdist(Xs.astype(np.float64), metric="cosine")
                act_d = pdist(As.astype(np.float64), metric="euclidean")

                if rep_d.std() < 1e-10 or act_d.std() < 1e-10:
                    continue
                rho, _ = spearmanr(rep_d, act_d)
                task_rhos.append(float(rho))

            if not task_rhos:
                continue
            arr = np.array(task_rhos)
            boot_means = [float(np.mean(rng.choice(arr, size=len(arr), replace=True)))
                          for _ in range(bootstrap_n)]
            boot_means.sort()
            ci_lo = boot_means[int(0.025 * bootstrap_n)]
            ci_hi = boot_means[int(0.975 * bootstrap_n)]

            key = f"L{l}_{pos}"
            results["per_layer"][key] = {
                "mean_rsa": round(float(arr.mean()), 6),
                "std": round(float(arr.std()), 6),
                "ci_95": [round(ci_lo, 6), round(ci_hi, 6)],
                "per_task": [round(v, 6) for v in task_rhos],
                "n_tasks": len(task_rhos),
            }
        if l % 8 == 0:
            im_key = f"L{l}_image_mean"
            lp_key = f"L{l}_last_preaction"
            im_v = results["per_layer"].get(im_key, {}).get("mean_rsa", "N/A")
            lp_v = results["per_layer"].get(lp_key, {}).get("mean_rsa", "N/A")
            log(f"  L{l}: img_mean RSA={im_v}  last_pre RSA={lp_v}")

    if results["per_layer"]:
        best_key = max(results["per_layer"], key=lambda k: results["per_layer"][k]["mean_rsa"])
        results["best"] = {"key": best_key, **results["per_layer"][best_key]}
        log(f"  Best RSA: {best_key} = {results['per_layer'][best_key]['mean_rsa']:.4f}")
    return results

    log(f"  Loaded in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")
    return model, processor

LOADER = {"openvla": load_openvla, "tracvla": load_tracvla, "nora": load_nora}


# ============================================================
# Input preparation
# ============================================================

def prepare_openvla(processor, instruction, image):
    prompt = f"In: What action should the robot take to {instruction}?\nOut:"
    inputs = processor(prompt, image).to(DEVICE)
    if "pixel_values" in inputs:
        inputs["pixel_values"] = inputs["pixel_values"].to(torch.bfloat16)
    return inputs


def prepare_tracvla(processor, instruction, image):
    prompt = (f"<|user|>\n<|image_1|>\n"
              f"What action should the robot take to {instruction}?<|end|>\n"
              f"<|assistant|>\n")
    inputs = processor(prompt, [image], return_tensors="pt").to(DEVICE)
    if "pixel_values" in inputs:
        inputs["pixel_values"] = inputs["pixel_values"].to(torch.bfloat16)
    return inputs


def prepare_nora(processor, instruction, image):
    messages = [{'role': 'user', 'content': [
        {'type': 'image', 'image': image},
        {'type': 'text', 'text': instruction}
    ]}]
    text = processor.apply_chat_template(
        messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
    inputs = processor(
        text=[text], images=[image], return_tensors='pt', padding=True)
    return {k: v.to(DEVICE) if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) else v
            for k, v in inputs.items()}


PREPARE = {"openvla": prepare_openvla, "tracvla": prepare_tracvla, "nora": prepare_nora}


# ============================================================
# Action generation (for action_mse method)
# ============================================================

def gen_action_openvla(model, processor, instruction, image, unnorm_key):
    inputs = prepare_openvla(processor, instruction, image)
    input_ids = inputs["input_ids"]
    if not torch.all(input_ids[:, -1] == 29871):
        input_ids = torch.cat(
            (input_ids,
             torch.tensor([[29871]], device=DEVICE, dtype=input_ids.dtype)),
            dim=1)
        if "attention_mask" in inputs:
            inputs["attention_mask"] = torch.cat(
                (inputs["attention_mask"],
                 torch.ones(1, 1, device=DEVICE,
                            dtype=inputs["attention_mask"].dtype)),
                dim=1)
    inputs["input_ids"] = input_ids
    with torch.no_grad():
        gen_ids = model.generate(
            inputs["input_ids"],
            attention_mask=inputs.get("attention_mask"),
            pixel_values=inputs.get("pixel_values"),
            max_new_tokens=7, do_sample=False)
    token_ids = gen_ids[0, -7:].cpu().numpy()
    disc = np.clip(model.vocab_size - token_ids - 1, 0,
                   model.bin_centers.shape[0] - 1)
    norm_act = model.bin_centers[disc]
    stats = model.get_action_stats(unnorm_key)
    mask = np.array(stats.get("mask", [True] * 7))
    high, low = np.array(stats["q99"]), np.array(stats["q01"])
    action = np.where(mask, 0.5 * (norm_act + 1) * (high - low) + low,
                      norm_act)
    del inputs, gen_ids
    return action.astype(np.float64), token_ids


def gen_action_tracvla(model, processor, instruction, image, _unnorm_key=None):
    inputs = prepare_tracvla(processor, instruction, image)
    with torch.no_grad():
        gen_ids = model.generate(
            input_ids=inputs["input_ids"],
            attention_mask=inputs.get("attention_mask"),
            pixel_values=inputs.get("pixel_values"),
            image_sizes=inputs.get("image_sizes"),
            max_new_tokens=7, do_sample=False)
    token_ids = gen_ids[0, -7:].cpu().numpy()
    vocab_size = model.config.vocab_size
    bins = np.linspace(-1, 1, 256)
    bin_centers = (bins[:-1] + bins[1:]) / 2.0
    disc = np.clip(vocab_size - token_ids - 1, a_min=0,
                   a_max=bin_centers.shape[0] - 1)
    norm_act = bin_centers[disc]
    del inputs, gen_ids
    return norm_act.astype(np.float64), token_ids


GEN_ACTION = {"openvla": gen_action_openvla, "tracvla": gen_action_tracvla}


# ============================================================
# Counterfactual instruction
# ============================================================

def cf_instruction(task_idx, cond, instructions, paraphrases):
    if cond == "wrong":
        return instructions[(task_idx + 1) % len(instructions)]
    elif cond == "empty":
        return ""
    elif cond == "shuffled":
        words = instructions[task_idx].split()
        random.Random(42 + task_idx).shuffle(words)
        return " ".join(words)
    elif cond == "paraphrased":
        return paraphrases[task_idx]
    raise ValueError(f"Unknown condition: {cond}")


# ============================================================
# Counterfactual: action MSE
# ============================================================

def run_cf_action_mse(arch, model, processor, tasks, instructions,
                      paraphrases, data_dir, unnorm_key, n_demos, n_timesteps):
    log("Counterfactual analysis (action MSE)")
    conditions = ["wrong", "empty", "shuffled", "paraphrased"]
    gen_fn = GEN_ACTION[arch]
    n_tasks = len(tasks)

    all_res = {
        "config": {
            "experiment": f"counterfactual_{arch}",
            "conditions": conditions,
            "n_tasks": n_tasks,
            "n_demos_per_task": n_demos,
            "n_timesteps_per_demo": n_timesteps,
            "method": "action_mse",
            "unnorm_key": unnorm_key,
            "seed": 42,
            "task_names": tasks,
        }
    }

    for cond in conditions:
        log(f"  Condition: {cond}")
        all_mses, all_tok_div = [], []
        per_task_mses = defaultdict(list)
        per_task_demo_mses = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(list))
        per_task_correct = defaultdict(list)
        per_task_cf = defaultdict(list)
        sample_n = 0

        for ti in range(n_tasks):
            cf_instr = cf_instruction(ti, cond, instructions, paraphrases)
            hdf5_path = os.path.join(data_dir, f"{tasks[ti]}_demo.hdf5")

            with h5py.File(hdf5_path, "r") as hf:
                for di in range(n_demos):
                    n_avail = hf[f"data/demo_{di}/actions"].shape[0]
                    for t in range(min(n_timesteps, n_avail)):
                        img = Image.fromarray(
                            hf[f"data/demo_{di}/obs/agentview_rgb"][t])

                        c_act, c_tok = gen_fn(
                            model, processor, instructions[ti], img, unnorm_key)
                        f_act, f_tok = gen_fn(
                            model, processor, cf_instr, img, unnorm_key)

                        mse = float(np.mean((c_act - f_act) ** 2))
                        tok_div = int(not np.array_equal(c_tok, f_tok))

                        all_mses.append(mse)
                        all_tok_div.append(tok_div)
                        per_task_mses[ti].append(mse)
                        per_task_demo_mses[ti][di].append(mse)
                        per_task_correct[ti].append(c_act)
                        per_task_cf[ti].append(f_act)

                        sample_n += 1
                        if sample_n % 200 == 0:
                            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
                            log(f"    {sample_n}/{n_tasks * n_demos * n_timesteps}")

        mse_arr = np.array(all_mses)
        global_d = (float(mse_arr.mean() / mse_arr.std(ddof=1))
                    if mse_arr.std(ddof=1) > 0 else 0.0)

        ca_all = np.concatenate(
            [np.array(per_task_correct[ti]) for ti in range(n_tasks)])
        cf_all = np.concatenate(
            [np.array(per_task_cf[ti]) for ti in range(n_tasks)])
        pdm = np.abs(ca_all - cf_all).mean(0).tolist()
        pds = np.abs(ca_all - cf_all).std(0).tolist()

        cond_res = {
            "global_metrics": {
                "paired_mse": {
                    "mean": round(float(mse_arr.mean()), 6),
                    "std": round(float(mse_arr.std()), 6),
                    "cohens_d": round(global_d, 4),
                },
                "per_dim_shift": {
                    "means": [round(v, 6) for v in pdm],
                    "stds": [round(v, 6) for v in pds],
                    "dim_names": ["dx","dy","dz","rx","ry","rz","gripper"],
                },
                "token_divergence_rate": round(float(np.mean(all_tok_div)), 4),
                "n_samples": len(mse_arr),
            },
            "per_task": {},
            "cross_task_variance": {},
        }

        per_task_ds = []
        for ti in range(n_tasks):
            tm = np.array(per_task_mses[ti])
            td = (float(tm.mean() / tm.std(ddof=1))
                  if tm.std(ddof=1) > 0 else 0.0)
            per_task_ds.append(td)

            demo_means = [float(np.mean(per_task_demo_mses[ti][di]))
                          for di in range(n_demos)]
            da = np.array(demo_means)
            dd = (float(da.mean() / da.std(ddof=1))
                  if da.std(ddof=1) > 0 else 0.0)

            entry = {
                "cohens_d": round(td, 4),
                "demo_level_cohens_d": round(dd, 4),
                "n_samples": len(tm),
                "mean_mse": round(float(tm.mean()), 6),
                "demo_mses": [round(v, 6) for v in demo_means],
                "instruction_correct": instructions[ti],
                "instruction_counterfactual": cf_instruction(
                    ti, cond, instructions, paraphrases),
            }
            cond_res["per_task"][tasks[ti]] = entry

        cond_res["cross_task_variance"] = {
            "cohens_d": {
                "values": [round(v, 4) for v in per_task_ds],
                "mean": round(float(np.mean(per_task_ds)), 4),
                "std": round(float(np.std(per_task_ds)), 4),
                "cv": (round(float(np.std(per_task_ds) /
                                   np.mean(per_task_ds)), 4)
                       if np.mean(per_task_ds) > 0 else 0.0),
            }
        }
        all_res[cond] = cond_res
        log(f"  {cond}: global d={global_d:.4f}  "
            f"cross-task mean={np.mean(per_task_ds):.4f}  "
            f"token_div={np.mean(all_tok_div):.3f}")

    ranking = sorted(
        conditions,
        key=lambda c: all_res[c]["global_metrics"]["paired_mse"]["cohens_d"],
        reverse=True)
    all_res["ranking_by_cohens_d"] = [
        {"condition": c,
         "cohens_d": all_res[c]["global_metrics"]["paired_mse"]["cohens_d"],
         "paired_mse_mean": all_res[c]["global_metrics"]["paired_mse"]["mean"]}
        for c in ranking
    ]
    return all_res


# ============================================================
# Counterfactual: cosine distance
# ============================================================

def run_cf_cosine_dist(arch, model, processor, tasks, instructions,
                       paraphrases, data_dir, n_layers, n_demos, n_timesteps):
    log("Counterfactual analysis (cosine distance)")
    conditions = ["wrong", "empty", "shuffled", "paraphrased"]
    prep_fn = PREPARE[arch]
    cf_layers = sorted(set(list(range(0, n_layers, 3)) + [n_layers - 1]))
    n_tasks = len(tasks)

    all_res = {
        "config": {
            "experiment": f"counterfactual_{arch}",
            "conditions": conditions,
            "n_tasks": n_tasks,
            "n_demos_per_task": n_demos,
            "n_timesteps_per_demo": n_timesteps,
            "method": "representation_cosine_distance",
            "layers_analyzed": cf_layers,
            "seed": 42,
            "task_names": tasks,
        }
    }

    for cond in conditions:
        log(f"  Condition: {cond}")
        per_layer_dists = {l: [] for l in cf_layers}
        per_task_dists = defaultdict(list)
        per_task_demo_dists = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(list))
        sample_n = 0

        for ti in range(n_tasks):
            cf_instr = cf_instruction(ti, cond, instructions, paraphrases)
            hdf5_path = os.path.join(data_dir, f"{tasks[ti]}_demo.hdf5")

            with h5py.File(hdf5_path, "r") as hf:
                for di in range(n_demos):
                    n_avail = hf[f"data/demo_{di}/actions"].shape[0]
                    for t in range(min(n_timesteps, n_avail)):
                        img = Image.fromarray(
                            hf[f"data/demo_{di}/obs/agentview_rgb"][t])

                        c_inputs = prep_fn(processor, instructions[ti], img)
                        with torch.no_grad():
                            c_out = model(**c_inputs,
                                          output_hidden_states=True)

                        f_inputs = prep_fn(processor, cf_instr, img)
                        with torch.no_grad():
                            f_out = model(**f_inputs,
                                          output_hidden_states=True)

                        for l in cf_layers:
                            c_r = c_out.hidden_states[l + 1][0, -1].float()
                            f_r = f_out.hidden_states[l + 1][0, -1].float()
                            cos_sim = F.cosine_similarity(
                                c_r.unsqueeze(0), f_r.unsqueeze(0)).item()
                            per_layer_dists[l].append(1.0 - cos_sim)

                        last_dist = per_layer_dists[cf_layers[-1]][-1]
                        per_task_dists[ti].append(last_dist)
                        per_task_demo_dists[ti][di].append(last_dist)

                        sample_n += 1
                        del c_out, f_out, c_inputs, f_inputs
                        if sample_n % 200 == 0:
                            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
                            log(f"    {sample_n}/"
                                f"{n_tasks * n_demos * n_timesteps}")

        cond_res = {
            "global_metrics": {"per_layer_cosine_distance": {}},
            "per_task": {},
            "cross_task_variance": {},
        }

        for l in cf_layers:
            arr = np.array(per_layer_dists[l])
            cond_res["global_metrics"]["per_layer_cosine_distance"][
                f"L{l}"] = {
                "mean": round(float(arr.mean()), 6),
                "std": round(float(arr.std()), 6),
                "n_samples": len(arr),
            }

        last_l = cf_layers[-1]
        last_arr = np.array(per_layer_dists[last_l])
        global_d = (float(last_arr.mean() / last_arr.std(ddof=1))
                    if last_arr.std(ddof=1) > 0 else 0.0)
        cond_res["global_metrics"]["last_layer_summary"] = {
            "layer": last_l,
            "mean": round(float(last_arr.mean()), 6),
            "std": round(float(last_arr.std()), 6),
            "cohens_d": round(global_d, 4),
            "n_samples": len(last_arr),
        }

        per_task_ds = []
        for ti in range(n_tasks):
            tm = np.array(per_task_dists[ti])
            td = (float(tm.mean() / tm.std(ddof=1))
                  if tm.std(ddof=1) > 0 else 0.0)
            per_task_ds.append(td)

            demo_means = [float(np.mean(per_task_demo_dists[ti][di]))
                          for di in range(n_demos)]
            da = np.array(demo_means)
            dd = (float(da.mean() / da.std(ddof=1))
                  if da.std(ddof=1) > 0 else 0.0)

            entry = {
                "cohens_d": round(td, 4),
                "demo_level_cohens_d": round(dd, 4),
                "n_samples": len(tm),
                "mean_cosine_distance": round(float(tm.mean()), 6),
                "demo_distances": [round(v, 6) for v in demo_means],
                "instruction_correct": instructions[ti],
                "instruction_counterfactual": cf_instruction(
                    ti, cond, instructions, paraphrases),
            }
            cond_res["per_task"][tasks[ti]] = entry

        cond_res["cross_task_variance"] = {
            "cohens_d": {
                "values": [round(v, 4) for v in per_task_ds],
                "mean": round(float(np.mean(per_task_ds)), 4),
                "std": round(float(np.std(per_task_ds)), 4),
                "cv": (round(float(np.std(per_task_ds) /
                                   np.mean(per_task_ds)), 4)
                       if np.mean(per_task_ds) > 0 else 0.0),
            }
        }
        all_res[cond] = cond_res
        log(f"  {cond}: last-layer cos_dist={last_arr.mean():.4f}  "
            f"cross-task d={np.mean(per_task_ds):.4f}")

    ranking = sorted(
        conditions,
        key=lambda c: all_res[c]["global_metrics"]["last_layer_summary"]["mean"],
        reverse=True)
    all_res["ranking_by_cosine_distance"] = [
        {"condition": c,
         "mean_cosine_distance": all_res[c]["global_metrics"][
             "last_layer_summary"]["mean"]}
        for c in ranking
    ]
    return all_res


# ============================================================
# Method selection
# ============================================================

def resolve_method(arch, condition, method):
    if method != "auto":
        return method
    if arch == "nora":
        return "cosine_dist"
    if condition == "untrained":
        return "cosine_dist"
    return "action_mse"


# ============================================================
# Main
# ============================================================

def main():
    global DEVICE

    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Counterfactual-only batch runner for VLA-SSD")
    p.add_argument("--arch", required=True,
                   choices=["openvla", "tracvla", "nora"])
    p.add_argument("--suite", required=True,
                   choices=["goal", "spatial", "object", "long"])
    p.add_argument("--condition", required=True,
                   choices=["trained", "untrained"])
    p.add_argument("--method", default="auto",
                   choices=["auto", "action_mse", "cosine_dist"])
    p.add_argument("--gpu", type=int, default=0)
    p.add_argument("--n-demos", type=int, default=10)
    p.add_argument("--n-timesteps", type=int, default=50)
    p.add_argument("--results-dir", default=None,
                   help="Override output directory")
    p.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true",
                   help="Run with 2 tasks, 1 demo, 2 timesteps")
    args = p.parse_args()

    DEVICE = f"cuda:{args.gpu}"
    key = (args.arch, args.suite, args.condition)

    if key not in CKPT_MAP:
        print(f"ERROR: Unsupported combination: {key}")
        print(f"Available: {sorted(CKPT_MAP.keys())}")
        sys.exit(1)

    ckpt_path = CKPT_MAP[key]
    data_dir = DATA_MAP[args.suite]
    results_dir = args.results_dir or RESULTS_MAP[key]
    method = resolve_method(args.arch, args.condition, args.method)
    tasks, instructions, paraphrases = _get_task_config(args.arch, args.suite)
    n_layers = ARCH_CFG[args.arch]["n_layers"]

    n_demos = 1 if args.dry_run else args.n_demos
    n_timesteps = 2 if args.dry_run else args.n_timesteps
    if args.dry_run:
        tasks = tasks[:2]
        instructions = instructions[:2]
        paraphrases = paraphrases[:2]

    log(f"Config: arch={args.arch} suite={args.suite} "
        f"condition={args.condition} method={method}")
    log(f"Checkpoint: {ckpt_path}")
    log(f"Data: {data_dir}")
    log(f"Results: {results_dir}")
    log(f"Tasks: {len(tasks)}  Demos: {n_demos}  Timesteps: {n_timesteps}")

    os.makedirs(results_dir, exist_ok=True)

    model, processor = LOADER[args.arch](ckpt_path)

    t0 = time.time()
    if method == "action_mse":
        unnorm_key = UNNORM_MAP.get(key)
        if unnorm_key is None:
            print(f"ERROR: No unnorm_key for {key}. "
                  f"Use --method cosine_dist or add key to UNNORM_MAP.")
            sys.exit(1)
        cf_res = run_cf_action_mse(
            args.arch, model, processor, tasks, instructions, paraphrases,
            data_dir, unnorm_key, n_demos, n_timesteps)
    else:
        cf_res = run_cf_cosine_dist(
            args.arch, model, processor, tasks, instructions, paraphrases,
            data_dir, n_layers, n_demos, n_timesteps)

    out_path = os.path.join(results_dir, "counterfactual_combined.json")
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(cf_res, f, indent=2)

    log(f"Saved -> {out_path}")
    log(f"Total: {(time.time()-t0)/60:.1f} min")

    del model, processor
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

脚本已创建: `/root/autodl-tmp/vla-ssd/scripts/counterfactual_batch.py` (884 行)

功能:
- 支持 `--arch openvla/tracvla/nora`, `--suite goal/spatial/object/long`, `--condition trained/untrained`
- `--method auto` 自动选择: trained openvla/tracvla → action_mse, nora 和所有 untrained → cosine_dist
- 内置全部 checkpoint/data/results 路径映射，匹配现有 pipeline 脚本的 task 顺序
- OFT checkpoint 自动合并 dataset_statistics.json 到 norm_stats
- `--dry-run` 快速验证, `--results-dir` 可覆盖输出目录
- `--gpu`, `--n-demos`, `--n-timesteps` 可调

用法:
```bash
python counterfactual_batch.py --arch tracvla --suite spatial --condition untrained
python counterfactual_batch.py --arch openvla --suite long --condition trained
python counterfactual_batch.py --arch openvla --suite object --condition untrained
```
